database_digest_kind: Research master byte digest; public SQLite is reconstructed from verified datasets.
display_rule: USD10m raised OR USD100m company valuation/deal consideration
privacy_model: Explicit column allowlist. No raw assertions, review JSON, mail IDs/links, cache text or private research payloads.

companies.description: Canonical company registry, including companies without linked deals. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

taxonomy.description: Subsector definitions used in the snapshot. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

aliases.description: Supported issuer naming aliases; subsidiaries and asset perimeters remain distinct. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

events_all.description: Every retained canonical event, including historical, pending, small and undisclosed observations. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

core_equity_all.description: Counting view for reviewed current-round pure equity with exact-day announcement and one preferred record per lifecycle. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

core_equity_display.description: Core equity counting view restricted to the display threshold. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

equity_round_announcements.description: Reviewed preferred equity financing announcements, including unknown cash, signed commitments or mixed packages. An announcement count is not a pure-equity cash-receipt total. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

display_deals.description: Display view using USD10m raised OR USD100m valuation/consideration. Unknown-value cases remain in events_all. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

ma_all.description: All acquisition observations and transaction stages. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

ma_announcements_2026.description: One preferred acquisition record per lifecycle announced in the 2026 scope. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

ma_closings_2026.description: One preferred acquisition record per lifecycle with a sourced closing date in the 2026 scope. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

reviewed_deals.description: Source-supported reviewed preferred announcements without blocking flags. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

sources.description: Public source links and publishers. Private evidence has opaque snapshot-scoped source IDs only. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

event_sources.description: Event-to-evidence links, without email text or private summaries. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

investors.description: Investor names extracted as deal metadata. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

event_investors.description: Deal investor relationships. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

lifecycle_groups.description: Reconciliation groups. Use events_all.lifecycle_rank=1 for preferred observations. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

quality_flags.description: Structured warning categories; raw private detail text is omitted. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

reviewed_event_relationships.description: Source-reviewed distinctions between rounds, instruments, proposals and non-additive headlines. Public source URLs only; raw private relationship evidence is withheld. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

registry_records.description: Every retained discovery-company record. A registry record is not a financing. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

registry_sources.description: Source links for discovery and directory records. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

company_financial_snapshots.description: Directory estimates, cumulative funding and valuation context. Never sum these as dated financing events. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

company_coverage.description: Registry and financial-event coverage; zero linked events does not prove zero deals. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

observations_all.description: One row per original retained event observation, projected to public financial facts. Conflicting assertions survive independently of preferred event values. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

public_market_context_facts.description: Public IPO, listed placement and traded-capitalization facts, kept separate from VC raised cash. Gross, net, proposed proceeds, shares, greenshoe and trading/offer prices remain separate quantities. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

observation_reviews.description: Explicit observation dispositions with public evidence and paraphrased issue categories. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

leads_all.description: Every retained discovery lead and disposition, including resolved and excluded context. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

unresolved_leads.description: Pending and inaccessible leads; these are not verified transactions. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

company_history_reviews.description: Actual company research queries, checked sources, dated dispositions and issuer/acquirer reference boundaries. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

audited_country_assertions.description: Country assertions with a valid public supporting URL. Company IDs belong to this snapshot; historical audit-company reference namespaces are labelled and numeric historical IDs are not promoted to current IDs. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

country_availability_metrics.description: Separate missing raw country, one normalized ISO, known multiple countries and known labels without a single ISO. Null ISO does not mean country was undisclosed; row counts may repeat the same issuer across different transactions. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

source_coverage.description: Source-family calendar and pagination coverage. Private Gmail searches and raw limitations are not published. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

completion_counts.description: Audit outcome counts, including pending and inaccessible cases. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

fx_rates.description: Sourced FX rates actually referenced by exported event conversions. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

event_fx_conversions.description: Native monetary values are retained alongside explicit FX conversions. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

company_search_logs.description: Logged indexed company searches; indexed URLs are not automatically claims of full article access. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

external_audit_response.description: One sanitized outcome per external audit finding, with public evidence and prior-public-event-ID to current-ID crosswalks. Free-text private audit reasons and original uploaded audit payload are withheld. Legacy helper review scopes are preserved; use the completion coverage audit for the expanded periods.

comparison_equity_announcements.description: Coverage-completion comparison equity announcements. No trends or sector scores calculated.

comparison_core_equity.description: Coverage-completion comparison core equity. No trends or sector scores calculated.

comparison_core_equity_cutoff.description: Coverage-completion comparison core equity cutoff. No trends or sector scores calculated.

credible_financing_disclosures.description: Coverage-completion credible financing disclosures. No trends or sector scores calculated.

financing_episodes.description: Coverage-completion financing episodes. No trends or sector scores calculated.

completion_periods.description: Coverage-completion completion periods. No trends or sector scores calculated.

completion_event_lineage.description: Coverage-completion completion event lineage. No trends or sector scores calculated.

completion_round_components.description: Coverage-completion completion round components. No trends or sector scores calculated.

completion_financial_claims.description: Coverage-completion completion financial claims. No trends or sector scores calculated.

completion_canonical_normalizations.description: Coverage-completion completion canonical normalizations. No trends or sector scores calculated.

completion_duplicate_decisions.description: Coverage-completion completion duplicate decisions. No trends or sector scores calculated.

completion_company_classifications.description: Coverage-completion completion company classifications. No trends or sector scores calculated.

audit_event_changes.description: Coverage-completion audit event changes. No trends or sector scores calculated.

company_identity_redirects.description: Coverage-completion company identity redirects. No trends or sector scores calculated.

finer_taxonomy.description: Coverage-completion finer taxonomy. No trends or sector scores calculated.

company_finer_classifications.description: Coverage-completion company finer classifications. No trends or sector scores calculated.

event_entity_classifications.description: Coverage-completion event entity classifications. No trends or sector scores calculated.

audit_input_provenance.description: Coverage-completion audit input provenance. No trends or sector scores calculated.

completion_reviews.description: Curated source decisions; private/raw review payloads are excluded.

discovery_review_queue.description: Public discovery ledger. Counts are leads, including duplicates/non-AI/small rounds; they are not a missing-deal count.

source_attributions.record_links: Record-specific deal/profile URLs appear in event_sources and completion_reviews.
